articles.title: ‘The Vampire Lestat’ Episode 3 Ending Explained: Jacob Anderson Explains Why that Big Kill Was the “Antithesis of Cathartic” for Louis
articles.summary: AMC's series 'The Vampire Lestat' recently aired its third episode, 'Toronto', concluding a significant plot arc. Character Louis de Pointe du Lac, portrayed by Jacob Anderson, finally exacts revenge on a villain whose actions have deeply impacted the show's narrative since its inception. This development marks a major turning point for the series, addressing a long-standing source of conflict and offering resolution for the protagonist.

articles.title: Solar storms don’t shock people directly — they induce electric currents in long metal, meaning power lines, pipelines and undersea internet cables become the very antennas that channel the damage into modern life
articles.summary: On March 13, 1989, the Hydro-Québec power grid suffered a complete collapse in under two minutes. This was triggered by a powerful coronal mass ejection (CME) from the Sun, which impacted Earth's magnetosphere, inducing currents that overloaded the grid. This incident highlights critical infrastructure's significant vulnerability to space weather phenomena, underscoring its importance for national security and disaster preparedness.

articles.title: India aims to be defence manufacturer, not just buyer: PM Modi
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi, in Kolkata, stressed India's strategic shift from being solely a defense buyer to a global producer. He asserted India's defence sector cannot remain a mere market for the world. Emphasizing self-reliance and indigenous manufacturing, this initiative aims to strengthen national security, reduce import dependence, and boost domestic industry.
